title: He Can't Tell Me

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca
sources.note: User-supplied EPUB: conclusion of SIX: Gorgon including the final reply; SEVEN: A Little Delusional through Boe saying he too wants to try feeding Gorgon. Mandarin adaptation; all theories stay explicitly unconfirmed.

notice: This episode adapts Super Supportive by Sleyca. Conversations are simplified for Mandarin reading, and choices vary your response while preserving the story’s events.
